historical_references.reference: Ishaavi is a Hindu female name, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ishavasya', which means 'belonging to Ishvara, or God'. Another reference suggests that the name Ishaavi may have been derived from the phrase 'Isha Anugraha' meaning 'God's grace'. This reference is found in the 12th century Sanskrit text 'Brahmanda Purana'.
